integrity: The compatibility condition is derived symbolically from the published recurrence. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The compatibility obstruction is proved only for q=i (Delta=0), a real x-directed boundary field, and the normalization u_0=1.
The result concerns the printed auxiliary recurrence, not existence or uniqueness of the physical nonequilibrium steady state.
No classification of all roots of unity or all exceptional boundary fields is claimed.
title: Root-of-unity compatibility obstruction in the one-end XXZ boundary recurrence
